protected_invariants.heading: matchingAndFreshness
protected_invariants.text: Docs assembler verifies full identity and canonical manifest rather than trusting digest echo. GitOps independently reproduces every present file raw byte/mode and every deletion from the exact committed candidate tree for merge/release and recomputes its digest; a worktree copy is not proof of that relation. Require committed target kind, scope completeness, matching tree reproduction receipt and all applicable hosted checks for that exact head. Timestamp alone cannot establish freshness. Recheck candidate/upstream at decision; change invalidates affected evidence. Snapshot is permitted only for explicitly labeled commit-scope content review and has status/limits that cannot establish full F ship readiness. A subsequent commit requires a new committed identity, reproduction and matching CI; no auto-promotion. Host may transport evidence; neither skill requires an installed sibling or new runtime.

protected_invariants.heading: verdictOwnership
protected_invariants.text: Docs owns F content findings, five-area scorecard and strict assembled artifact. GitOps owns hosted/git/package readiness. F Ship Verdict PASS requires content PASS and matching ready response for requested ship gate; missing/uncertain/failing required evidence yields FAIL. E Release gate verdict remains docs-content only. Merge/release PASS additionally requires committed target kind and independent exact-tree manifest reproduction. Snapshot content PASS never implies merge/release readiness.

protected_invariants.heading: assembly
protected_invariants.text: F retains Inversion Analysis, Adversarial Findings, scorecard, Ship Verdict and conditional minimum fixes or proposed commands. Cite GitOps evidence/limits under existing verdict/findings slots; do not append GitOps generic report to strict F output. No numeric pass threshold invented.

protected_invariants.heading: schemaValidation
protected_invariants.text: Use oneOf request/response branches keyed kind and candidate target_kind; schema constrains known fields/states. Focused fixture tests verify canonical hashing, target-tree relation, gate matching and freshness. Implement these comparisons within recipe instructions and existing test utilities; no additional runtime, collector or schema engine is required.

protected_invariants.heading: gateScope
protected_invariants.text: The unchanged F-style full ship review defaults to release scope and requires the complete release readiness/command plan before Ship Verdict PASS. A caller explicitly narrowing the gate to commit or merge receives that labeled partial scope; its PASS must say commit-only or merge-only and must not claim the original full ship gate passed. Generic GitOps may assess any declared gate.

protected_invariants.heading: contentManifestContract
protected_invariants.text: "pathRules": "Repo-relative exact POSIX paths using /; reject leading slash, empty path/components, . or .. components, backslash, NUL, CR and LF. Do not resolve/normalize case, Unicode or symlinks into a different identity. Duplicate exact paths are errors, never last-write-wins. Only regular files are supported in this seam; symlink/gitlink/special targets return unsupported/blocked.",

protected_invariants.heading: contentManifestContract
protected_invariants.text: "entries": "Each entry has exactly path, state, mode, sha256. For present, mode is 100644 or 100755 and sha256 is raw file-content bytes SHA-256 (not Git object ID; no newline/text/filter transformation). For deleted, mode and sha256 are null. A deletion must be present at base and absent from reviewed target. Represent rename as deleted old path plus present new path; no implicit rename detection.",

protected_invariants.heading: contentManifestContract
protected_invariants.text: "ordering": "Sort entries lexicographically by their path encoded as UTF-8 bytes, ascending. Input ordering differences must canonicalize identically; duplicate paths fail before sorting.",

protected_invariants.heading: contentManifestContract
protected_invariants.text: "identityEquality": "Match target_kind, base_sha, head_sha, manifest_version, exact normalized manifest and content_digest, not only an echoed digest. Changing snapshot to committed changes target kind/digest even if content bytes happen to match; commit/head evidence is renewed.",

protected_invariants.heading: snapshotAcceptance
protected_invariants.text: target_kind=snapshot with gate=merge or release always blocks readiness regardless of head SHA/green CI. With gate=commit it may support a labeled commit-only content review of exact snapshot bytes; the response states no hosted/main/release certification and must not reuse HEAD checks as tests of those bytes. Full F default release gate cannot PASS from this state.

protected_invariants.heading: Evidence limits and ordered proposal checks
protected_invariants.text: Schema acceptance establishes shape only. A proposal is not execution, authority, authenticated CI, tree reproduction or evidence truth. Inspect actual evidence references and gate-specific pass/fail/unknown/not-applicable observations separately; unknown required evidence blocks readiness. Preserve request authority exactly; review authority permits proposals and grants no commit, merge, tag or publish action. Proposed step preconditions and evidence references must be nonempty and describe observations or future prerequisites honestly. Never label future planned commands executed.

protected_invariants.heading: Evidence limits and ordered proposal checks
protected_invariants.text: For the declared gate, verify a nonempty ordered plan: commit and candidate checks for commit scope; then merge with main parity for merge scope; then merged-release preflight, package, tag creation plus dual-remote tag pushes, and publish/download verification for full release scope. Require package before tag creation. Verify actual resolved remote identities; send one exact tag name and the same verified tag object to both remotes. Bind package version, tag target and proposal evidence to the reviewed candidate or separately verified integrated main as applicable. Missing phase, reversed package/tag order, origin-only publication, different tag object, placeholders or missing evidence are mechanical failures; passing these comparisons still cannot authenticate evidence.

protected_invariants.heading: Evidence limits and ordered proposal checks
protected_invariants.text: Snapshot commit-only content review reports supplied-byte observation and its limits, and cannot become full F PASS. Merge/release requires committed-tree reproduction plus applicable exact-head hosted evidence and fresh upstream checks. Static fixtures demonstrate these bounded comparisons only; actual hosted/tree readiness remains an independent observation.
